notes: All operational, capture, specimen and analysis contents are synthetic.
Locations inherit validated interior points from mock-official-observations.json.
The source object is fixture metadata and must not be written into Firestore document data.
Capture histories include 90 first captures and 30 later recaptures.
Zero capture values only occur in events with explicit sampling effort.
2026-10-23 appended 50 deterministic Daan genetic-sampling records: 38 captured individuals and 12 environmental samples, including five compact three-site family clusters.
2026-10-23 deterministic spatial revision uses EPSG:3826 calculations and retains synthetic_mock provenance.
